# Yashada Enterprises

> Yashada Enterprises is a Nashik-based industrial supplier founded in 2005 by Dilip Brahmankar.
> We manufacture self-adhesive tapes and are authorized distributors of industrial electrical
> components including cable ties, cable glands, heat shrink sleeves, panel accessories, and busbar systems.

## Key Information

- **Founded**: 2005

## What We Sell

### Self-Adhesive Tapes (Manufactured In-House)
- Surface Protection Tape
- Anti-Skid Tape
- Security Void / Tamper-Evident Tape
- Double-Sided Tape (foam and tissue carrier)
- PVC Insulation Tape
- Paper Masking Tape (Abro brand)
- BOPP Packing Tape
- Aluminium Foil Tape
- Polyester Film Tape
- Cross Filament Tape
- HDPE Tarpaulin Tape

### Electrical Components (Authorized Distributor)
- Nylon Cable Ties (Surelock brand)
- Brass Cable Glands (single & double compression)
- PVC Cable Glands
- Heat Shrink Sleeves (Woer brand)
- Busbar Sleeves (heat-shrinkable)
- Busbar Insulators & Supports (finger-type, DMC/SMC)
- MCB DIN Rail Channels (TS35)
- PVC Cable Duct / Wiring Channels
- End Sealing Lugs (Bootlace Ferrules)
- Aluminium & Copper Cable Lugs
- Cable Wire Zip Ties
- Spring Panel Hinges
- DC Panel Locks & Keys
- Tie Mounts / Sticking Saddles
- Solar MC4 Connectors
- U-Shape Rubber Gaskets
- PVC Sleeves & Ferruling Tubes
- Spiral Sleeves
- Lugs Crimping Tools

## Authorized Brands
- **Steelgrip**: Electrical insulation tapes
- **Abro**: Masking, packaging, and adhesive tapes
- **Woer**: Heat shrink sleeves and tubing
- **Surelock**: Nylon cable ties

## Business Hours
Monday – Saturday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST

## Service Area
Nashik, Maharashtra, India. Supplies to panel builders, OEMs, and electrical contractors across Maharashtra and India.
